openQuestions.followUpPrompt: Define and test Swan space-credential revocation semantics across member removal and managing-app policy denial.
openQuestions.question: Does Proposal 0016 intentionally define removed-member space credentials as non-revocable leases until expiry, or must Swan enforce a membership/client-policy epoch on every read?

openQuestions.followUpPrompt: Specify permissioned blob retention semantics and add update/delete/last-reference tests.
openQuestions.question: Must permissioned blob readability track live record reachability, or are blobs intentionally retained at space scope after the last record reference is removed?

surfaces.label: HTTP/XRPC public and authenticated route surface
surfaces.notes: Reviewed route registration and handlers; retained public firehose, OAuth/login/recovery, proxy, mutation and streaming findings.
surfaces.riskArea: Authentication, method binding, request admission, streaming and error/resource behavior

surfaces.label: OAuth, DPoP, session and service JWT enforcement
surfaces.notes: Reviewed issuance and verification; retained lifetime, replay-capacity, metadata-fetch, login-admission and lifecycle-race findings.
surfaces.riskArea: Credential type, freshness, replay, scope, audience and lifecycle binding

surfaces.label: Permissioned authorization and capability enforcement
surfaces.notes: Retained read-credential registration mutation, cross-space deletion replay, post-revocation credential use and signing-race findings.
surfaces.riskArea: Space membership, read/write separation, delegation, notification and cross-space binding

surfaces.label: Public and permissioned blob isolation
surfaces.notes: Demonstrated by source and checked-in tests that permissioned-intended uploads enter the public namespace before promotion; retained streaming and reservation findings.
surfaces.riskArea: Anonymous namespace reachability, staging, promotion, streaming and spool budgets

surfaces.label: Repository, CAR, MST, CID and recovery verification
surfaces.notes: Retained deniable-binding and MST resource findings; PLC key-continuity semantics remain deferred.
surfaces.riskArea: Exact-content authentication, import bounds, CAS and durable key continuity

surfaces.label: DID, PLC, DNS and outbound request resolution
surfaces.notes: Retained document-binding, IPv6 classification, URL canonicalization and proxy DNS findings; operator-only configured-origin candidate was rejected.
surfaces.riskArea: Document identity, PLC audit state, URL/IP canonicalization, DNS pinning and timeouts

surfaces.label: SQLite durability, lifecycle and concurrency
surfaces.notes: Retained public/permissioned write, signing, sync and blob lifecycle races plus unbounded durable-ledger growth.
surfaces.riskArea: Linearization, retries, durable ledgers, publication and account/space transitions

surfaces.label: Notifications and outbound delivery
surfaces.notes: Retained service-JWT freshness, deletion-token scope and read-capability registration findings.
surfaces.riskArea: Service authentication, space binding, registration authority, retries and deletion state

surfaces.label: Parser, serialization and resource exhaustion
surfaces.notes: Retained object-depth, WebSocket, CAR/MST, remote-fetch and admission-budget findings; lab-only parser tools were rejected.
surfaces.riskArea: Nesting, aggregate work, body/frame rates, spool, disk, memory and response deadlines

surfaces.label: Production versus laboratory configuration
surfaces.notes: Retained production-composable lab trust/profile findings; explicitly invoked lab CLI, Mailpit and reference-relay candidates were rejected.
surfaces.riskArea: Lab trust material, profile selection, SMTP/HTTP exceptions and reference overlays

surfaces.label: Secrets, Docker, Compose and build/deployment boundary
surfaces.notes: Retained runtime-secret and Docker-context findings; same-UID disposable credential observations were rejected.
surfaces.riskArea: Runtime operator secrets, build context/cache and local artifact custody

surfaces.label: SwiftPM dependencies, generated profiles and scripts
surfaces.notes: Package manifests, lockfile, profiles, checksums and scripts were inventoried. No source-supported dependency-substitution or remote code-execution path survived.
surfaces.riskArea: Pins, generated-wire integrity, script quoting and artifact verification
